title: My first Mallworld experience today
content: I've been sleeping weird lately. I quit weed 2 months ago and have been having vivid dreams, but today I had the most intense lucid dream of my life, & it was during a 1 hour nap. Also I've been traveling through Europe for a month now and my schedule has been different. I've never experienced anything like it before. I fell asleep and was in front of a mall. The sky was dark as it always is in my dreams. I 100% knew I was dreaming but it seemed even more vivid than real life so I didn't want to wake up. Then I went into the mall and everything was so real. It felt like I was in Las Vegas (I lived there a short time many years ago). It had the feeling of a casino but there was no gambling or slots or anything. The ceilings were super high and it was kitschy like Vegas with gold pillars and brightly colored stores and restaurants. I just walked around for what felt like hours. There were crowds of people but only some of them could see me. In the food court there was a Greek restaurant takeout. I asked the lady where the restrooms were but she just chuckled at me. I kept looking for a restroom but whenever I'd go to where I thought the restroom was it would morph into something else. But I didn't need to pee, I couldnt sense myself having a body even. I could travel really fast...I would focus on the end of a hallway and boom I was there. The people in the crowds never acknowledged me but some of them looked smug like they knew something I didn't. Some NSFW stuff happened but it's kind of embarrassing & I don't want to talk about it. I really didn't want to leave. I was having fun there (I did find the restroom thing annoying)...but floating around a big glitzy mall was fun. Then I had a friend wake me up for a walk and it was so jarring. I yelled "noooo!" at him but we had dinner reservations so I didn't have a choice. So far it's been one of the weirdest experiences of my life. I have been to mallworld many other times but it was never a clearly lucid dream & I never had control. The other times I was just along for the ride and I forget almost everything when I wake up. That was not the case today. Anyway, just wanted to share my experience. Thanks for listening.
